flat_protocol.physics: Isaac nominal; bounded upright reset variations
flat_protocol.evaluation_mode: deterministic frozen actor; no PPO, no reset on failure
flat_protocol.scope: Isaac Flat: 36 cases x 32 reset seeds; no Rough/Stairs qualification

32 reset seeds are not independent training seeds
30s constant-command segments intentionally exceed the 10s training resampling time
No MuJoCo qualification in this screen
